concerns.text: The plan validates the physics‑teacher model by computing SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS against the *same* physics‑generated videos that serve as the model’s output (see T4.1–T4.3). Because the ground‑truth for the physics teacher is definitionally identical to its predictions, these metrics are guaranteed to be perfect (SSIM = 1, PSNR = ∞, LPIPS = 0). The subsequent paired t‑test (T5.1) therefore compares a constant‑value distribution to the neural‑teacher’s scores, violating the independence assumption of the test and rendering the statistical conclusion circular and non‑informative.
